contracts: Only C5 MODEM_SYSCON CLK_CONF1 at600a9c14. Header POR0; independent groups400/4/200/1fb give16 configurations. BB_MISC only0/full group; named FE/BT11..21 and reserved22..31 remain unsupported.

Actual MODEM_APB accessibility comes only from existing applied BootAnalog permissionsSome&1. WIFI_APB bit10 cannot supply its own grant. Missing/withdrawn provider rejects before read/write or allocation; previously accepted requests remain latched.

Getter/report are requests only: no effective Hz, WiFi APB engine, MAC/PHY/RF readiness, calibration result, IRQ, event, new advance or deadline work. Old I2C/160MHz/PLL/BOD/SAR behavior is unchanged.

Exact clock accesses require validated ROM and no earlier pending reset. Old watchdog service precedes partial refusal. CPU reset retains, HP/Chip clear and raw exit drops the optional owner. Strict owned refusals are ModelLimit; adjacent/off-profile words retain prior mapping.

Four clock fixtures cover provider withdrawal/no self-grant, actual13-instruction four-group RMW under plain/UnitCost, unsupported groups/partial/closed-provider CSR preservation, reset/raw transitions and watchdog precedence.

MAC600ad858 has no qualified whole-word data contract. The strict exact boundary always rejects after old watchdog service: no0, ACK, MAC allocation, guessed state or fabricated guest access exception. No neighboring MAC address is newly handled.

Two frontier fixtures check actual LW/SW/SB under plain/UnitCost, destination/CSR/owner preservation, neighboring/off-profile mapping and watchdog precedence. This is error classification for missing hardware, not a MAC implementation.

reviews.scope: Nine stable fingerprints before exact MAC-frontier classification; no P1/P2, source-only.

retainedPriorBoundary.description: Earlier known unimplemented MAC read was classified as a guest access fault. The exact new classification stops the model without returning data or changing guest CSR state.

Fixed C5 wdev_reg.h exposes RNG only; modem/reg_base.h exposes SYSCON/LPCON, not this MAC block.
